roomPool16x9.sceneSummary: Great Hearth Undercroft: lower keep chamber directly beneath courtyard lightwells, where barred amber grate-slits pour late sunbeams across an unlit dragonstone hearth, tattered banners, and blazing iron floor braziers.
Chandelier Vault: quiet sub-level vault beneath the upper flagstones, anchored by a raised carved stone wheel medallion, blazing iron candle chandelier, and cool silver-blue wall sconces.

roomPool16x9.sceneSummary: Sunken Garden Cistern: shallow stone basin room beneath overgrown palace gardens, where daylight spills through a collapsed turf breach onto creeping ivy, dry carved stone, and bronze torches.
Garrison Undercroft: sealed sub-level weapon vault beneath the outer curtain wall, stocked with iron weapon racks, notched bucklers, tattered black banners, and roaring ember braziers.
Cliffside Statue Vault: quiet stone shrine room built just inside a steep ravine wall, where narrow violet cliff-slit glass casts twilight across three blind statue alcoves and hanging iron lanterns.
Lower Aqueduct Cistern: damp lower conduit chamber catching mossy masonry seams, an inset water cistern base, heavy hanging iron wall chains, and glowing orange iron sconces.
Under-Keep Record Vault: dry cellar archive tucked beneath keep halls, packed with recessed stone shelves of crumbling leather tomes, cracked ceramic urns, and tall floor candelabras.

Deep Basalt Vault: charcoal-stone vault chamber lined with heavy foundation masonry, where high crimson-violet iron sconces and roaring molten amber braziers light stepped pilasters and forgotten blades.

cards.title: Courtyard Archway

cards.cardArtSummary: Sheltered stone battlement niche bathed in soft amethyst candle glow: an ornate swinging silver incense censer suspended cleanly beside white prayer tapers, trailing pale-lavender consecrated smoke above sealed ward scrolls (zero people).

battlegrounds.sceneSummary: Battleground 1 · Sun-Baked Canyon Gravel: Covering the ENTIRE lower ~85% from the bottom edge nearly to the top strip lies a wide, completely flat level sun-baked terracotta gravel and smooth weathered red sandstone bedrock ground across both combat sides—strictly clear with zero protruding boulders, zero ruins, zero cracks, and zero side cliff walls. Top 15% border only: Tucked tightly along ONLY the top ~15% horizontal strip parallel to the top margin runs ONE straight east-to-west stratified terracotta canyon cliff wall base with low weathered red boulders beneath a slim midday sky.

Battleground 2 · Flat Red Mesa Plateau: Covering the ENTIRE lower ~85% from the bottom margin up to the top strip lies a broad, level, smooth matte red-ochre sandstone mesa plateau firm underfoot across both left and right sides—strictly flat and bare with zero pits, zero boulders, and zero shrubs anywhere inside the bottom 85% arena. Top 15% border only: Tucked tightly along ONLY the top ~15% horizontal strip parallel to the very top edge run flat-topped red-orange sandstone mesa rims and distant hoodoo tips under midday sky.

Battleground 3 · Dry Sandstone Arroyo Floor: Covering the ENTIRE lower ~85% from the bottom edge nearly to the top rim lies a wide, flat, dry red sandstone arroyo floor in natural midday light across both sides—completely open underfoot with zero pillars, zero water pools, and zero boulders in the lower 85% arena. Top 15% border only: Tucked tightly along ONLY the top ~15% horizontal strip parallel to the top edge runs ONE straight west-to-east layered red canyon sandstone lip lined with dry weathered boulders.
